periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight medial inclination toward the nasal bridge at the superior poles.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval morphology; the vertical dimension of the eye patch is approximately twice the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering with the inferior margin ending in a sharpened point significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness; the dark band extends from the shoulder line down to the axillary region, covering roughly one-third of the visible lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A clear white cranial gap exists between the medial edges of the ears, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Low smoothness; the ear apices exhibit a slightly pointed, non-hemispherical profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible dark, circular focal pigmentation located on the central-inferior region of the scrotal sac.
